details: Malicious package. Poses as a "RobloxAPI Access" library (author "Aristal-Development"). The exported `robloxmessage()` in `RobloxAPIACCESS.py` is an information stealer: it collects host, IP and geolocation details, extracts Discord tokens from the Discord clients' Local Storage leveldb, decrypts Chrome saved passwords, grabs browser cookies via `browser_cookie3`, and sends the results to a Discord webhook. In 0.0.2 the webhook is hardcoded (1084236782247362680); 0.0.1 ships the same stealer with the webhook left blank. A comment claims it is for educational purposes only. Published 2023-03-18; removed from PyPI.
